idea: Rays from an object bend through a convex lens and meet again: where they meet is the image, set by the distance and the focal length.

parameters.name: objectDistance
parameters.why: From well inside the shortest focal length to well beyond the longest, so real and virtual images both appear.

parameters.name: focalLength
parameters.why: Strong to weak convex lenses whose focal points stay on the graph.

parameters.name: objectHeight
parameters.why: Tall enough to see the rays separate, short enough to stay below the top of the lens.

moves: Nothing moves on its own; the rays, the image and the focal points follow the sliders.
steps: The parallel ray bends through F′
The rays meet at a real image
Inside the focal length the image is virtual
